image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small turtle, likely a mud or musk turtle, resting on sandy ground. The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace covered in patches of green algae or moss. Its head is extended, showing dark skin with distinct yellow linear markings on the neck and face. One front limb is visible, appearing stout with dark scales. The background is a soft-focus blur of sand and earth tones.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet and sharp claws.

The tail is not visible in this frame; it is occluded by the rear of the shell and the angle of the shot.
